page.layout: One page, title page. Centred title block with large capitals at the top, then smaller italic and roman lines in the middle, a rule, the author line, another rule, and the imprint at the foot. Handwritten annotations in the margins and an ownership stamp are not printed text and are left out.

main_text.l: Ex antiquæ Ecclesiæ Catholicæ Testimoniis lacoplenissimis confectum:
Iuxta Ecclesiæ ANGLICANÆ, & Protestantium omnium unanimem sententiam:
In Gloriam Gratiæ Divinæ, Meritorum CHRISTI, & ad veram pietatis professionem salutarem.
Autore R. P. THOMA MORTONO Episcopo Dunelmensi[?].

page.notes: The date line is hard to read at this scan resolution. The letters look like MDGXXXVII, but the third letter could be a C (1637) or a G, so it is marked [?]. "Dunelmensi" is also uncertain at the scan's resolution and is marked [?]. The pencilled and ink annotations (the marks "Gf", "Morton", "K", "8") and the library stamp are not printed text and were left out.
